pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Plans for indie hackers, AI native startups, and enterprises

tokenBilling.question: How are tokens billed?
tokenBilling.answer: Tokens are billed based on model usage and API calls.

markupPricing.question: Do you mark up provider pricing?
markupPricing.answer: Pricing depends on provider rates and usage tiers.

billingStructure.question: How is billing structured for BYOK, Pay-As-You-Go vs Enterprise?
billingStructure.answer: Enterprise plans offer volume pricing and custom agreements.

apiLimits.question: What are the API rate limits for each plan?
apiLimits.answer: Free plans have 50 requests/day, Pay-as-you-go has high global limits, and Enterprise has optional dedicated limits.

modelAccess.question: Do I get access to all AI models?
modelAccess.answer: Free plans include 25+ free models, while paid plans include access to 300+ models from 60+ providers.

dataRetention.question: How long is my data retained?
dataRetention.answer: Data retention periods vary by plan and can be configured in your privacy settings.

supportChannels.question: What support channels are available?
supportChannels.answer: Free users get community support, Pay-as-you-go gets email support, and Enterprise gets dedicated Slack channel support.

apiCompatibility.question: Is OpenRouter compatible with OpenAI SDK?
apiCompatibility.answer: Yes, OpenRouter is fully compatible with OpenAI SDK and works out of the box.

creditExpiration.question: Do credits expire?
creditExpiration.answer: Credits don't expire and can be used with any model or provider in our network.

customModels.question: Can I use custom models?
customModels.answer: Enterprise plans support custom model deployments and fine-tuned models.

autoTopUp.question: How does auto top-up work?
autoTopUp.answer: Auto top-up automatically adds credits when your balance drops below a threshold you set.

dataPrivacy.question: How is my data protected?
dataPrivacy.answer: We implement enterprise-grade security with configurable data policies and privacy controls.

multipleOrgs.question: Can I have multiple organizations?
multipleOrgs.answer: Yes, you can create and manage multiple organizations for different teams or projects.

bulkDiscounts.question: Are there bulk discounts available?
bulkDiscounts.answer: Enterprise plans offer volume pricing and bulk discounts based on usage commitments.

slaGuarantees.question: Do you offer SLA guarantees?
slaGuarantees.answer: Enterprise plans include 99.9% SLA guarantees with contractual commitments.

apiKeyManagement.question: How do I manage API keys?
apiKeyManagement.answer: You can create, rotate, and manage API keys with credit limits and expiration dates.

promptCaching.question: What is prompt caching?
promptCaching.answer: Prompt caching reduces costs and latency by caching frequently used prompts and responses.

fallbackProviders.question: What happens if a provider goes down?
fallbackProviders.answer: OpenRouter automatically falls back to other providers to ensure high availability.

websocketSupport.question: Do you support WebSocket streaming?
websocketSupport.answer: Yes, we support real-time streaming for chat completions and other interactive use cases.

batchProcessing.question: Can I process requests in batches?
batchProcessing.answer: Yes, we support batch processing for efficient handling of large volumes of requests.

modelComparison.question: How do I compare different models?
modelComparison.answer: Use our model comparison tool to evaluate performance, pricing, and capabilities across models.

costOptimization.question: How can I optimize costs?
costOptimization.answer: Use auto-routing, prompt caching, and our cost monitoring tools to optimize your spending.

enterpriseFeatures.question: What enterprise features are included?
enterpriseFeatures.answer: Enterprise includes SSO/SAML, dedicated support, custom SLAs, and advanced security controls.

dataExport.question: Can I export my usage data?
dataExport.answer: Yes, you can export activity logs and usage data in various formats including CSV and JSON.

regionalDeployment.question: Do you offer regional deployments?
regionalDeployment.answer: Enterprise customers can request regional deployments for data residency requirements.

modelVersioning.question: How do you handle model versioning?
modelVersioning.answer: We support multiple versions of models and provide migration paths for deprecated versions.

troubleshooting.question: How do I troubleshoot API issues?
troubleshooting.answer: Use our comprehensive logs, error codes documentation, and support channels for troubleshooting.

scalability.question: How does OpenRouter scale with my needs?
scalability.answer: Our infrastructure auto-scales to handle traffic spikes and growing usage patterns.

integrations.question: What integrations do you support?
integrations.answer: We integrate with popular development tools, monitoring platforms, and cloud services.

compliance.question: What compliance standards do you meet?
compliance.answer: We comply with SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, and other industry-standard compliance frameworks.

backupRecovery.question: What backup and recovery options exist?
backupRecovery.answer: We maintain automated backups and offer point-in-time recovery for enterprise customers.

performanceMonitoring.question: How can I monitor API performance?
performanceMonitoring.answer: Use our analytics dashboard and integrate with observability platforms for performance monitoring.

customRouting.question: Can I customize model routing?
customRouting.answer: Yes, you can configure custom routing rules based on cost, performance, or data policies.

tokenLimits.question: Are there token limits per request?
tokenLimits.answer: Token limits vary by model. Check our documentation for specific limits and capabilities.

experimentalFeatures.question: Do you offer experimental features?
experimentalFeatures.answer: Yes, we regularly release experimental features for testing new capabilities and models.

partnerProgram.question: Do you have a partner program?
partnerProgram.answer: Yes, we offer partnership opportunities for resellers, integrators, and technology partners.

academicPricing.question: Is there academic or non-profit pricing?
academicPricing.answer: We offer special pricing for educational institutions and qualifying non-profit organizations.

migrationSupport.question: Do you help with migration from other platforms?
migrationSupport.answer: Yes, our team provides migration assistance and best practices for switching from other AI platforms.

customTraining.question: Can you help with custom model training?
customTraining.answer: Enterprise customers can work with our team for custom model training and fine-tuning services.

multiRegionSupport.question: Do you support multi-region deployments?
multiRegionSupport.answer: Yes, we offer multi-region support for global applications requiring low latency access.

errorHandling.question: How should I handle API errors?
errorHandling.answer: Implement exponential backoff, check error codes, and use our retry mechanisms for robust error handling.

webhookSupport.question: Do you support webhooks for notifications?
webhookSupport.answer: Yes, we support webhooks for usage alerts, billing notifications, and system status updates.

loadBalancing.question: How does load balancing work?
loadBalancing.answer: We automatically distribute requests across providers and regions for optimal performance and reliability.

securityAudits.question: Do you conduct security audits?
securityAudits.answer: We undergo regular security audits and penetration testing to maintain the highest security standards.

apiVersioning.question: How do you handle API versioning?
apiVersioning.answer: We use semantic versioning and provide backward compatibility with clear deprecation timelines.

developerTools.question: What developer tools do you provide?
developerTools.answer: We offer SDKs, CLI tools, testing frameworks, and comprehensive documentation for developers.

usageAnalytics.question: What usage analytics are available?
usageAnalytics.answer: Get detailed insights into usage patterns, costs, performance metrics, and model effectiveness.

communitySupport.question: Is there a developer community?
communitySupport.answer: Yes, join our Discord community for discussions, support, and to share experiences with other developers.

featureRequests.question: How can I request new features?
featureRequests.answer: Submit feature requests through our feedback channels or community forums for consideration.

emergencySupport.question: Do you offer emergency support?
emergencySupport.answer: Enterprise customers receive priority emergency support with guaranteed response times.

dataProcessing.question: How do you process sensitive data?
dataProcessing.answer: We offer configurable data processing options including on-premises and private cloud deployments.

modelUpdates.question: How often are models updated?
modelUpdates.answer: Models are updated regularly as providers release new versions. We notify users of significant changes.

costPrediction.question: Can I predict usage costs?
costPrediction.answer: Use our cost calculator and budgeting tools to predict and control usage costs effectively.

concurrentRequests.question: What are the concurrent request limits?
concurrentRequests.answer: Concurrent request limits scale with your plan and can be increased for enterprise customers.

testingEnvironment.question: Do you provide testing environments?
testingEnvironment.answer: Yes, we offer sandbox environments for testing and development without affecting production usage.

intro.paragraph1: OpenRouter, Inc. ("we", "us" or "our") respects your privacy and we are committed to protecting it through our compliance with this Privacy Policy. We have created this Privacy Policy to inform you of our policies regarding the collection, use and disclosure of personal data and the choices you have associated with that information. Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Privacy Policy have the meaning given to them in our Terms of Service.
intro.paragraph2: This Privacy Policy applies to all personal data collected through any written, electronic, or oral communications, as you:
listItems: Access the website located at https://openrouter.ai/ and all corresponding webpages and websites that link to this Privacy Policy (the "Site");
Interact with applications on third party websites and services, if those applications include links to this Privacy Policy;
intro.paragraph3: Before using our Site and Service, please carefully read our Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy. By using this Site or Service, you consent to the collection and use of your personal data in accordance with this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service.

collection.title: 1. Collection of Personal Data
collection.content: We collect personal data when you use our Site and our Service. Personal data is any information that relates to you, identifies you personally or could be used to identify you including, but not limited to: your name, mailing address, email address, and telephone number.

voluntaryData.title: Personal Data You Voluntarily Provide to Us
voluntaryData.content: The personal data we collect from you may include:
items: Information that you provide by filling in forms on our Site or Service.
Records and copies of your correspondence (including email addresses), if you contact us.
Your responses to surveys that we might ask you to complete for internal purposes.
Details of transactions you carry out through our Site.
Your search queries on the Site.

automaticData.title: Personal Data Collected Automatically
automaticData.content: As you navigate through and interact with our Site or Service, we may use automatic data collection technologies to collect certain information about your device, browsing actions and patterns.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Personal Data
howWeUse.content: We will only use your personal data as described in this Privacy Policy or as disclosed to you prior to such processing taking place.

sharing.title: 3. How We Share and Disclose Your Personal Data
sharing.content: We may share or disclose your personal data in specific circumstances as outlined in this policy.

rights.title: 4. Your Rights and Choices
rights.content: Depending on where you live and the laws that apply in your country of residence, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We implement and maintain physical, technical and administrative security measures designed to protect Your Data from accidental loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration and disclosure.

contact.title: 6. Contact Information
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@openrouter.ai.

whyUse.question: Why should I use OpenRouter?
whyUse.answer:
OpenRouter provides a unified API to access major LLM models, aggregate billing, and track usage with analytics.

We pass through provider pricing while pooling uptime, so you get the same provider rates with a unified API and automatic fallbacks for better reliability.

howToStart.question: How do I get started with OpenRouter?
howToStart.answer:
Create an account and add credits on the Credits page. Credits are used for LLM inference.

Use the chat room or create API keys and start using the API. See our quickstart guide.

howBilled.question: How do I get billed for my usage on OpenRouter?
howBilled.answer:
Pricing is per model and may differ for prompt/completion, images, and reasoning tokens. See the model page for details.

We compute cost from provider token usage and deduct it from your credits. Review your history in Activity.

Include usage: {include: true} in requests to receive usage data in the response. We pass through provider pricing; we charge a small fee when purchasing credits.

whatVariants.question: What are model variants?
whatVariants.answer:
Variants are suffixes that modify behavior. Static variants are available on specific models, listed in the models API:

• :free – free model with low rate limits
• :extended – longer context length
• :thinking – reasoning by default

Dynamic variants can be used on all models:

• :online – attach web results to the prompt
• :nitro – optimize for faster throughput
• :floor – prioritize lowest price

serviceOverview.title: OpenRouter Service Overview
serviceOverview.content: OpenRouter operates a large language model aggregator where users may use the Site to access third-party application programming interfaces ("APIs") to use a variety of generative artificial intelligence models listed on the Site ("AI Models"). OpenRouter may add or remove AI Models from the Service at any time.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content: You must be at least 13 years of age to use the Service. By agreeing to these Terms, you represent and warrant to us that: (a) you are at least 13 years of age; (b) you have not previously been suspended or removed from the Service; and (c) your registration and your use of the Service is in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. If you are under 18 years of age, you must have your parent or guardian's permission to use the Service. If you are using the Service on behalf of an entity, organization, or company, you represent and warrant that you have the authority to bind that organization to these Terms and you agree to be bound by these Terms on behalf of that organization.

accounts.title: Accounts and Registration
accounts.content1: To access most features of the Service, you must register for an account. When you register for an account, you may be required to provide us or our authentication platform with some information about yourself, such as your email address or other contact information. You agree that the information you provide to us is accurate and that you will keep it accurate and up-to-date at all times. When you register, you will be asked to provide a password. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password, and you accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account. If you have reason to believe that your account is no longer secure, then you must immediately notify us at support@openrouter.ai.
accounts.content2: The Service allows creation of two account types: organizational accounts and individual accounts. An organizational account is managed by an administrative user ("Admin User") who can invite individuals from the Admin User's organization ("Authorized Users") to the organizational account. Authorized Users may only use the Service as configured by the Admin User, with such configurations which may include, without limitation, enabling prompt logging, chat logging, zero data retention, model training, and other settings. Authorized Users may also create separate individual accounts to access the Service.

prepaidCredits.title: 4.1 Pre-Paid Credits; Refunds
prepaidCredits.content: Access to the Service, or to certain features of the Service, may require you to pay fees for pre-paid credits that are linked to your account ("Credits"), along with payment processing fees and transaction fees. Before you pay any fees, you will have an opportunity to review and accept the fees that you will be charged. Currently, OpenRouter requires users to purchase Credits to make API calls and access the Service, with a minimum and maximum purchase amount of $5 and $25,000 per transaction, respectively. Once purchased, refunds for unused Credits may be requested within twenty-four (24) hours from the time the transaction was processed. If no refund request is received within twenty-four (24) hours following the purchase, any unused Credits become non-refundable. To request a refund within the eligible period, you can use the refund button on the Credits page. The unused credit amount will be refunded to your payment method; the platform fees are non-refundable. Cryptocurrency payments are never refundable.

creditExpiration.title: 4.2 Credit Expiration; Auto Recharge
creditExpiration.content: OpenRouter reserves the right to expire unused credits three hundred sixty-five (365) days after purchase. When purchasing Credits, you will have the option to automatically add Credits to your account by charging the payment method of your choosing when your available Credits are below a threshold amount you have set on your account ("Auto Recharge"). If you elect the Auto Recharge option, you authorize OpenRouter to automatically charge payments to your account. You may update or cancel Auto Recharge at any time through your account page.

currency.title: 4.3 Currency; Payment Processing
currency.content: OpenRouter will charge the payment method you specify at the time of purchase. You authorize OpenRouter to charge all sums as described in these Terms, for the Service you select, to that payment method. OpenRouter accepts payment through our third-party payment processors, Stripe and Coinbase. All payments made through Stripe are in U.S. dollars, and payments made through Coinbase are through your crypto wallet. See Stripe's payment terms and conditions here, and Coinbase payment terms and conditions here. If you choose to pay using Coinbase, you represent and warrant that the cryptocurrency and source of funds for the cryptocurrency you use do not constitute the proceeds of a financial crime or any other crime under applicable law.

feeChanges.title: 4.4 Changes to Fees
feeChanges.content: If OpenRouter changes the fees for the Service, including by adding additional fees or charges, OpenRouter will provide you advance notice of those changes. If you do not accept the changes, OpenRouter may discontinue providing the Service to you.
